title: SQL-Zero: Self-Evolving Text-to-SQL
abstract: arXiv:2609.04697v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training a competitive Text-to-SQL agent usually depends on human-annotated natural-language/SQL pairs, which are expensive, domain-specific, and a bottleneck for scaling to new databases. We show it is possible to train a competitive solver with zero annotated pairs. We introduce SQL-Zero, a proposer-solver self-play in which a challenger and a solver start from the same base LLM and the only ground truth is execution against the database itself. The challenger generates SQL pairs calibrated to the solver's current difficulty (targeting "hard but solvable"), and both roles are updated with GRPO in alternating turns, with a template-level repetition penalty on the challenger to prevent diversity collapse. Training on BIRD databases with no labels, self-play improves over the zero-shot base on BIRD dev by 6.6 points at 3B and 7.3 points at 7B. It also scores higher than a matched control trained under the same recipe on human BIRD gold ov

translated_abstract: 训练一个具有竞争力的Text-to-SQL（文本到SQL）智能体通常依赖于人工标注的自然语言/SQL配对数据，这些数据成本高昂、局限于特定领域，并且是扩展到新数据库时的瓶颈。我们证明了可以在零人工标注配对的情况下训练出具有竞争力的求解器。我们提出了SQL-Zero，这是一种提议者-求解者自我博弈框架，其中挑战者和求解者从同一个基础大语言模型出发，唯一的真值标准是在数据库本身上执行SQL的结果。挑战者根据求解者当前的能力水平生成难度经过校准的SQL问题与查询配对（目标是“困难但可解决”），两个角色交替地使用GRPO进行更新，并对挑战者施加模板级的重复惩罚以防止多样性坍塌。在无标注的BIRD数据库上进行训练后，自我博弈方法在BIRD开发集上比零样本基础模型提升了3B规模6.6分、7B规模7.3分。在与采用相同训练方案的匹配对照组的对比中，它在人工标注的BIRD金标准数据上也取得了更高的分数。
tldr: SQL-Zero提出了一种无需任何人工标注数据的提议者-求解者自我博弈训练框架，仅以数据库执行结果作为真值信号，通过GRPO交替更新挑战者与求解者两个角色，在BIRD基准上显著超越零样本基线（3B提升6.6分、7B提升7.3分），且优于相同配方下用人工标注数据训练的对照组。
en_tdlr: SQL-Zero introduces a zero-annotation proposer-solver self-play framework for Text-to-SQL that uses database execution as the sole ground truth, alternating GRPO updates between a challenger and a solver, and outperforms zero-shot baselines by 6.6 points (3B) and 7.3 points (7B) on BIRD dev while surpassing matched controls trained with human-annotated gold data.
